About Me

I'm an enterprise SaaS seller with 9+ years across data infrastructure, cloud, AI compute and cybersecurity. I sell to CTOs, CISOs, Heads of Data and engineering leaders, often starting with the engineers who feel the problem and closing at CXO level.

I've closed $6M+ ARR at 120-130% of quota, from self-sourced new logos, expansion and renewals. I've often been one of the first sellers at a company, building the playbook, the pipeline and the partner motion with no SDR support. I've also led teams as a player-coach, hiring and coaching AEs, SDRs and BDRs while carrying a quota.

Most recently I was Enterprise Account Executive – Technical at Firebolt, a cloud analytical database, covering the US, EU and India. Before that I sold data integration at DataZip (now OLake), cybersecurity at Encryption Consulting, cloud, edge and GPU infrastructure at G Core Labs, and telematics SaaS at Azuga.

I also build AI into my own sales process: signal-based outbound, account research and deal reviews. The tools are on my GitHub. Based in Bengaluru, open to Senior / Enterprise AE and player-coach sales leadership roles.
